show.description: “Hum Tum Aur Baby” is a dramatic love story about Deepika, a woman trapped in a toxic marriage with Sidharth, who discovers betrayal, hidden identities, and a secret pregnancy. Torn between heartbreak, revenge, and new love with Mohit, she fights to reclaim her dignity and protect her unborn child amidst family conspiracies and burning secrets
